prompts.walk_down:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Mosslume protagonist six-frame down-facing walking animation SOURCE atlas, transparent PNG.
Input image 1: approved four-direction protagonist design reference; preserve this exact character identity and costume. Generate the next animation poses, not another character lineup.
All six frames face DOWN toward the viewer, matching the upper-left front/down pose of image 1. Both eyes visible throughout. Character travels toward bottom of game screen.
Style: original cozy top-down/three-quarter 2D pixel-game character sprite artwork matching image 1, simplified into clear deliberate square pixel clusters rather than smooth painting. Same young traveler, short tousled dark chestnut hair, warm light-medium skin, teal jacket, ivory shirt, orange neckerchief, brown cuffed trousers and sturdy brown boots; small canvas satchel on anatomical LEFT hip with shoulder strap. No costume changes. Design to be readable as a logical 44-pixel tall character on a 64x64 game frame, enlarged for source-art review. Soft neutral matte light with consistent shading, no baked night light. Two hands and two feet only.
Movement phases for a seamless six-frame walking cycle, each pose visibly different: 1 left foot forward contact and right foot back; 2 left foot bears weight, body slightly lowered, right heel lifts; 3 right leg passes under torso with raised knee, body slightly higher; 4 right foot forward contact and left foot back; 5 right foot bears weight, body slightly lowered, left heel lifts; 6 left leg passes under torso with raised knee, ready to connect naturally back to frame 1. Arms counter-swing gently against legs, jacket hem and satchel follow subtly. The character does not walk across the sheet and does not turn.
Composition: a wide 3-column by 2-row atlas of SIX equal square invisible cells, reading order top-left to bottom-right. Exactly one complete character per cell. All cells use the identical camera, magnification and local ground plane: character pelvis centered at 50% cell width, planted boot soles at 86% of cell height, crown near 16%. There must be generous empty transparent space all around every figure, no character crosses a cell edge. Static camera; walk IN PLACE. Maintain exactly the same hair volume, head/body proportions, costume, satchel position and pixel scale across frames. No visible grids, dividers, borders, labels, numbers, text, backgrounds, colored halos, ground shadows, trails, motion lines, duplicate limbs or extra objects. Genuine alpha transparency in all empty space.
